title: An alcohol replaces chlorine
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Methanol reacts with an acid chloride to make an ester. The acyl chloride’s Cl is replaced by O–CH₃ and the C=O group is retained.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of ethanoyl chloride under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Ethanoyl chloride is treated with methanol. Which major organic product forms after workup? Methanol reacts with an acid chloride to make an ester. The acyl chloride’s Cl is replaced by O–CH₃ and the C=O group is retained.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
